svg.title: Figure 3-4. DFMEA failure chains — sheet 2 of 3 (DFM)
svg.desc: DFMEA failure chains, sheet 2 of 3 (DFM rev 0.13): failure modes DFM-010 to DFM-013 (8 failure modes, 13 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-4 · DFMEA failure chains — sheet 2 of 3
DFM rev 0.13 · BL-007 · draft · DFM-010 … DFM-013 · 13 causes on this sheet
FAILURE CAUSE · O · D · AP · ACTIONS (STEPS 4–6)
Separate the camera from the car bus only
while energised; restore the stock camera
Intercept switch stays in intercept when released
Analog switch U1 or U2 stuck in the intercept (NO) position, or its
SBU1 drive stuck high (device-side driver or MCU pin, UK-06)
Pull-down R2 or R3 open, so IN floats when the device stops driving
U1/U2 overstressed or latched up by box supply transients above
the DG419LE absolute maximum (V+ = VL = VIN with no regulator;
the SMF16A clamp D4 only starts to conduct above its 16 V…
Intercept switch stays in pass-through when driven
End effect: Erratic or excessive steering or braking
Analog switch U1 or U2 stuck in the pass-through (NC) position, or
SBU1 drive lost or held low (driver open, R2/R3 short)
The 5 V SBU1 drive does not reach the DG419LE logic-high
threshold with VL tied to VIN (about 14 V), so the switch does not
change over or changes over only at some temperatures…
Harness box loses its supply while the car is on
Ignition branch to the box open (crimp, connector) or D1 open,
Box VIN shorted to ground (TVS D4 short, connector or wiring)
Clamp diode short loads or grounds a vehicle bus in the
Schottky clamp D2 or D3 (BAS40SDW) short or leaky
Camera bus left unterminated in intercept
Termination resistor R7 open together with R8 or the P13-P15
loopback open. One open alone leaves 120 ohm and a recessive
edge of about 0.06 us, so it is latent (FMEDA SG-009 FMD-035)…
Termination resistor R7 or R8 short (FMEDA SG-009 FMD-036);
pass-through is not affected (R7/R8 are on the NO side)
Connect the device to the vehicle buses,
power and ignition, and report harness
Harness disconnected or intermittent while driving
End effect: Loss of lateral control while engaged
Connector not fully latched at installation, or vibration loosens it
Stock camera path open inside the harness box
Open in the harness box stock path (U1/U2 channel open, solder

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
